name: Darn Talongrip
summary: Darn Talongrip is an orc scout stationed along the frontier of the Stonetalon Mountains near Malaka'jin. He monitors local threats in the crags and helps coordinate Horde communication between forward outposts and regional commanders.

sections.title: Frontier Scout of Stonetalon
sections.body: Darn Talongrip watches the rugged ascents leading into Stonetalon from the southern Barrens. Stationed in the settlement of Malaka'jin, Darn directs recruits toward the Horde's new fronts in Ashenvale. His post serves as an early line of contact for travelers winding upward into contested peaks.

sections.title: Eyes for the Command
sections.body: From his post in Malaka'jin, Darn ensures messages and frontline reports reach key commanders like Kadrak at the watch tower in the northern Barrens. Outlying encampments in these mountains operate under constant pressure, making Darn's role as a sentry and courier essential to keeping the Horde vanguard informed.

faq.answer: Darn Talongrip is an orc scout stationed in Malaka'jin in the southern reaches of the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: Where can Darn Talongrip be found?
faq.answer: He can be found in the troll settlement of Malaka'jin in the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: What is his role in Stonetalon?
faq.answer: Darn directs new recruits to Kadrak in the northern Barrens to help defend the Horde's outposts in Ashenvale.

faq.q: Who is Kadrak, and why does Darn send travelers to him?
faq.answer: Kadrak is a Horde commander stationed at the watch tower in the northern Barrens, heading up the Horde's Ashenvale campaign. Darn directs new recruits to him to help defend the Horde's new fronts in Ashenvale.

angles.text: Darn Talongrip keeps early watch along the ascent into Stonetalon, acting as a valuable contact for Horde adventurers fresh from the Barrens.
Like many orc scouts, Darn embraces the harsh conditions of the frontier, standing watch amid jagged rocks and hostile wildlife.
